tiers.label: Powerful Lv40
notes: Crusader is not worth the cost right now. Not every enchant is best in slot, but each should speed up levelling.
Chest and legs kits are interchangeable between Mystic and Forceful Thick Armor Kits.
Neck enchants are marked as not worth it in the sheet.

tiers.label: Under 10g
notes: Melee: pick Fiery for raw damage or Recovery for sustain.
Dual wield: one Fiery and one Recovery gives some health and good damage.

tiers.label: Under 1g
notes: Lesser Agility or Lesser Strength are good options.
